summary: Flex hoses are used to connect the clean agent cylinder to the manifold in multiple cylinders arrangement. Flex hoses are constructed of high pressure hydraulic rubber in the 1/4″ size and stainless steel corrugated inner core with stainless steel braided in the 1/4″ size. Both ends has 7/16″ 20 UNF Flare connection. It comes with various options of fittings of 7/16-20 UNF Flare Connection and 1/8” NPT Threads.
